sara_ml: Uploaded lyra-13b bundle to staging S3. Files: model.pt, tokenizer/*, config.json. Path: s3://redwood-staging/models/lyra-13b/2026-11-03-0812. Ping @kyle_research for registry entry.

kyle_research: Got it. Can you paste checksums and the original source URL (HF or mirror)? Need license info too.

sara_ml: Checksums below and source link. License: Apache-2.0.

```
sha256(model.pt)=a3f4b9c12d8e3f0a7b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3
sha256(tokenizer.json)=5f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4
```
source: https://huggingface.co/lyra/lyra-13b/tree/v1.0

ingest-bot: artifact-ingest: Upload received. Initiating automated provenance checks. Expected manifest: model.pt, tokenizer/{vocab.json,merges.txt}, config.json. Status: queued.

ben_ops: Heads up — if this will be used in Dedicated/private, we need KMS wrapping info. Also mark compliance tag (public/internal/restricted).

sara_ml: Compliance tag: public-open. No embargo. Not KMS-wrapped for hosted. Will add KMS metadata if customer requests Dedicated.

ingest-bot: checksum-verify: model.pt matches provided sha256. Tokenizer files OK. Source URL accessible. Notarization pending manual signature.

carla_se: I can run the manual source provenance check. Please provide HF commit hash and the exact artifact snapshot ID.

sara_ml: HF commit: 92c4b1e. Snapshot ID: lyra-13b-v1.0-20261103. Link: https://huggingface.co/lyra/lyra-13b/commit/92c4b1e

carla_se: Verified origin and license headers. Performing signature.

carla_se: Signed. Signature ID: sig_20261103_01 (carla-se@redwood). Notation added to S3 object metadata.

ingest-bot: provenance-complete: Signature verified. Registry record created: model_id=lyra-13b@v1.0, registry_url=https://registry.redwood/models/lyra-13b/v1.0, s3_prefix=s3://redwood-staging/models/lyra-13b/2026-11-03-0812.

eva_eval: I'll queue quantization experiments (q8b and q4f) and baseline evals tomorrow morning. Any specific eval suites or promptsets to run?

sara_ml: Use our standard instruction-following baseline + LLM-eval subset. I'll upload promptsets to s3://redwood-eval/lyra13b_baseline.zip and populate README with expected metrics. Also include tokenization edge-case list.

kyle_research: Please add regression watchers for truthfulness, extractive QA F1, and instruction accuracy. Tag baseline run as "v1.0-hosted-baseline".

ben_ops: Canary policy: route 5% of traffic to quant q8 if p50 latency < 120ms and no QA regression >2% against baseline. Auto-revert if thresholds breached.

sara_ml: Thanks — will add README and short intake checklist to the S3 prefix (provenance, checksums, signature, eval promptset, compliance tag). :thumbsup:

kyle_research: Thanks all. File a follow-up ticket if evals show regressions or if any artifacts fail later verification.

sara_ml: Acknowledged. I'll post the final registry PR link once we promote to production namespace."
